title: antennaria saxatilis
intro: Antennaria saxatilis, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial plant native to North America, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Antennaria saxatilis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria saxatilis also include antispasmodic and antitumor properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
